hardware_profile.name: adaptive
hardware_profile.selection_reason: start at logical/physical batch 256 with no query chunking; after OOM use 128/64/32 physical micro-batches with accumulation, then halve the all-pairs query chunk from all when the 32-sample tier still cannot fit

metadata.mechanism: per-key leave-one-out counterfactual influence over projected support

cost_model.memory_control: query_chunk_size and leave_one_out_chunk_size bound each materialized batched counterfactual call; retained training graphs still scale with all query chunks
cost_model.score_wrapper_scaling: ceil(query_token_count / query_chunk_size) x (1 + ceil(context_key_count / leave_one_out_chunk_size)) batched calls per head

per_head_constructor.mechanism: leave-one-active-context-key recomputation of projected quantum support followed by a diagonal key/support influence readout

numerical_stability.zero_norm_key_behavior: zero normalized probe and finite zero contribution

per_head_constructor.quantum_resource_note: Exact statevector simulation establishes functional behavior only; it does not establish hardware speedup or quantum advantage.
